department: Graduate School of Precision Engineering (GSPRE), Faculty of Science

deadline.value: Doctoral applications at the University of Bern are accepted throughout the year once a thesis supervisor agrees (fall semester registration runs September 1 to October 15).
deadline.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must organise a research project and a supervisor before submitting the GSPRE application.
supervisor.quote: potential students must themselves organise a research project and supervisor

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: A master's or licentiate from a Swiss university or ETH, or an equivalent degree, is needed for doctoral admission.
entry_route.quote: hold a master's degree or a licentiate from a Swiss university or Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, or an equivalent university degree

notes: Applicants with a foreign master's must register at the University of Bern before signing their employment contract. Each candidate has an advisor, a co-advisor and a mentor.
name: PhD Program in Precision Engineering
